old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-254w","title":"Packet-format DIO vectors are generated from the production helper they claim to oracle","description":"Final correctness review: test/vectors/generate_packets_timing.py packets_formats_vectors() imports RPL_DIO_FIELDS and dio_packet_bytes from python/src/lichen/packets/formats.py to generate rpl_dio_skeleton and all dio_rank_* expected hex. python/tests/test_packets_timing.py then regenerates with the same helper and only independently checks length/tail, so corruption in the DIO base layout can update both implementation and vectors undetected. The metadata also omits the distinct RFC 6550 Flags octet: dio_packet_bytes emits two zero octets after DTSN but comments both as reserved, and RPL_DIO_FIELDS lists only Reserved. Replace generation with a literal independent 24-byte DIO base encoder (Instance, Version, Rank, G/MOP/Prf, DTSN, Flags, Reserved, DODAGID), independently pin every rank vector byte, and keep production comparison separate.","acceptance_criteria":"DIO expected bytes and field metadata are spec-derived without importing the production packet-format helper; tests independently pin all base fields and edge ranks.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T14:53:07.535531Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T14:53:07.535531Z"}
